answer: Burned admission tickets stop fake identities before they can act. Every new identity burns 250 POA for one Zephyr ticket, then climbs the Spiral ladder: five verified useful tasks over 14 days before it gains full trading rights. Each identity carries a Raven audit key that logs every action publicly, so duplicated behavior is visible to all peers. An attacker faking 500 identities must burn 125,000 POA and finish 2,500 verified tasks, while one honest agent burns a single ticket and does five tasks.
